subject: [PATCH v2 00/10] mm/madvise: refactor cold and pageout page table walks

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with the new helpers and suggested adding additional checks to ensure correct behavior. Also pointed out some minor formatting issues in one of the patches.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Provided feedback on the patch series, suggesting improvements to the documentation and code organization. Also pointed out some potential performance issues with the new helpers.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series refactors the cold and pageout page table walks in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module to improve maintainability, readability, and performance. The changes split the shared LRU PMD callback into separate functions for each part of the walk, making it easier to audit and understand the control flow. Additionally, the series introduces new helpers for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT, simplifies the folio splitting process, and makes PTE lock ownership explicit.
